messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a gradual traffic nudge (NA -> EU regional steering) tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This is non-incident deploy; just routing policy swap + small DNS weight tweak. Who can own the window?
kevin: I can own the window. What’s the planned slope and timeout per step?
akshay: Thanks Kev. Proposal: 10% increments every 5m over ~50m, hold 10m after last step for smoke. If any step shows error spike or tail latency >100ms P50 -> rollback.
sylvia: Can you post the exact commands we’ll run for the routing controller and the DNS change? I’ll prep the smoke checklist.
maria: Good Q. Routing controller: `rk apply --policy regional-slope --from na --to eu --increments 10 --step 300` DNS change is a TTL-friendly weight update via console (no zone edits).
sylvia: Smoke checklist draft: 1) health check 200 on /health across sample hosts; 2) steady p50/p95 in grafana dashboard (edge-routes/latency); 3) request success rate >99.5% on canary cohort; 4) no 5xx spike in nginx logs.
josh: I’ll add the exact curl loop for health checks: ```for h in $(cat canary_hosts.txt); do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" http://$h/health; done```
kevin: Nice. For rollback: we’ll reverse the slope back to original weights immediately and bump TTL to 30s, and if we're seeing continued issues we’ll point traffic to dedicated fallback region (config name: `eu-fallback`).
akshay: Who will run the DNS weight change? I can do routing controller steps; prefer SRE to run DNS weight bump to avoid console confusion. @sylvia can you confirm you'll run DNS?
sylvia: I can run DNS. I’ll be on call during the window. I’ll also post updates to this thread at each major step.
maria: Ownership assigned: kevin = deployment owner / orchestration; akshay = routing-controller operator; sylvia = DNS/operator + smoke lead; josh = logs/alerts and quick rollback script; maria = coordinator / observer.
deploy-bot: Scheduled window created: 2025-04-18 02:00 UTC — ops-window-id 29841 — reminder +30m and +5m.
kevin: Preflight tomorrow 01:30 UTC — smoke run and canary warmup. If everyone +1 here I’ll lock the window. :thumbsup: 
akshay: +1
sylvia: +1
josh: +1
maria: +1 — I’ll add the recovery playbook to the runbook page and attach the curl script.
kevin: Cool. I’ll post step-by-step updates during the roll (increment / hold / final confirmation). If anything looks off we cut back to 0 and escalate.
sylvia: One more note — set alert threshold for redis queue depth; we saw drift last time during region fanout. If depth >1000 we abort.
maria: Noted. I’ll add queue depth to the smoke dashboard. See you all in the window. :rocket:
